hints.title: WELCOME, MINER!
hints.text: Move with the arrow keys or W A S D (on a tablet: the D-pad). Brown earth is dug simply by walking into it.
hints.task: Dig your way east, towards the glowing tiles.

hints.title: BOULDERS
hints.text: Grey boulders are heavy. Dig away the ground under one and it falls; one resting on rock or on another boulder rolls off sideways into an open hole beside it. A boulder that lands on you is fatal, so never wait in a hole or a shaft below one.
hints.task: Dig down the shaft below you to the first glowing tile, before you dig near any boulder.

hints.title: AN ELEMENT
hints.text: Walk onto a glowing tile to collect the element. Its card opens beside the mine, and the clock waits while you read it.
hints.task: Collect it. The STATUS panel then shows 1/5.

hints.title: SOLID ROCK
hints.text: Grey rock cannot be dug. The gold lies just behind it - so close, and no way through here.
hints.task: Take the indium, then find the way round the rock to the gold.

hints.title: THE EXIT HATCH
hints.text: This hatch is the way out - but it stays barred until every element of the mine is collected. Try it: walk into it.
hints.task: Find every element still missing - the STATUS panel counts them - then come back here.

hints.title: ON THE CLOCK
hints.text: The ⏰ clock in the STATUS panel is running. Every second left on it when you leave is worth 10 points.
hints.task: Take the last elements and go back up to the hatch.
